significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling: the residual-stream "signed margin" and "local instability" jointly place jailbroken and borderline prompts in a "low-certainty band" that predicts both jailbreak success and over-refusal before generation. This is a substantial behavioral phenomenon plus a representational account, though not a causal mechanism showing that certainty itself produces refusal; relative to the refusal direction documented by Arditi et al., "Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction" (2024), it would constrain which boundary geometry should accompany two distinct safety failures rather than merely identify a refusal component. Verified false—particularly if successful jailbreaks are routinely high-certainty—would rule out low decision certainty as a general explanation and triage basis, so the two branches are determinate and informative. In the topic-substitution check, generic mechanistic LLM safety would not merit this score; the specific cross-failure predictive coupling, which is false of the median refusal-direction hypothesis, supports the above-median rating.

reach.justification: The named handle is a "single-forward-pass triage monitor" based on the "certainty score," which is ex ante because it flags inputs "before the output is produced" and permits escalation or a conservative default while there is still an action window. After per-model recalibration, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—jailbreaks and borderline cases should occupy a low-certainty band—rather than merely supplying a procedure to search for an unconstrained direction. The asserted scope covers several open-weight model families and multiple attack classes, with auditors and deployment practitioners able to gate expensive checks, although the claim expressly leaves "frontier transfer" untested and allows high-certainty jailbreaks that limit coverage. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: mechanistic safety alone supplies no deployable early-warning handle, whereas this claim specifically supplies an ex-ante predictor with practitioner uptake.
